steps.en: SSH into a clean VPS, download the latest installer and run it with sudo
steps.zh: SSH 进干净 VPS，下载最新安装脚本并用 sudo 运行

steps.en: Builds the AmneziaWG kernel module (DKMS) from the Amnezia PPA, tunes the box, enables UFW + Fail2Ban
steps.zh: 从 Amnezia PPA 以 DKMS 装内核模块，调优并加固整机

steps.en: Reboot when it asks and re-run the same command; after two rounds it prints the completion banner
steps.zh: 它要求时重启并重跑同一命令，两轮后打印安装完成横幅

steps.en: Writes two client profiles — configs, QR codes and vpn:// links — into /root/awg/
steps.zh: 把两个客户端的配置、二维码和 vpn:// 链接写进 /root/awg/

steps.en: Scan the QR (or paste the vpn:// link) in the Amnezia VPN app on your phone
steps.zh: 在手机的 Amnezia VPN 应用里扫码，或粘贴 vpn:// 链接

steps.en: Handshakes with randomized headers DPI cannot fingerprint; your traffic exits the VPS
steps.zh: 以随机化包头完成握手，DPI 无指纹可匹配，流量从你的 VPS 出去

value.en: A DPI-resistant self-hosted VPN on a cheap VPS — you never hand-write a key, an iptables rule or a sysctl
value.zh: 一台便宜 VPS 上的抗 DPI 自建 VPN——全程没手写过一行密钥、iptables 或 sysctl

sources: README.en.md Quick Start (wget -O install_amneziawg_en.sh … ; sudo bash ./install_amneziawg_en.sh ; two reboots, re-run to resume)
README.en.md 'What the installer changes on your server' (DKMS module from the Amnezia PPA, UFW + Fail2Ban, sysctl/swap tuning, /root/awg/)
README.en.md 'After installation' (QR code and vpn:// import into the Amnezia VPN app)
